reviewType: independent read-only review of correction-v2 delta for ES5-REVIEW-1 and ES5-REVIEW-2
verdictScope: Correction of the two prior template-import-surface findings only; source review plus independently checked retained RED/GREEN evidence. This is not an ES5 completeness, qualification, portability, full producer closure or R0 verdict.

closedFindings.reason: Les chaînes cuites non vides des TemplateMiddle/TemplateTail sont conservées en arguments concat, comme TypeScript5.9.3 visitTemplateExpression. Le témoin tail initial et ses contrôles tail/middle/escape/empty sont présents dans les observations SDK et le log natif GREEN. Le log RED montre le premier témoin exécuté et rejeté sur la source avant correction.

Les tagged templates avec ou sans substitutions reçoivent les tableaux cooked/raw du helper. La première borne ] vue par tryConsumeDefine est rétablie. Les contrôles substitution, head, tail, escape, tableau dans substitution, no-substitution, tag direct, require et cooked invalide correspondent aux observations SDK retenues. Le log RED montre le témoin substitution initial exécuté et rejeté sur la source avant correction.

directDeltaAnalysis.plainTemplateSurface: Nonempty cooked literals are kept in the same lexical order as SDK concat calls; empty cooked tails remain absent, as SDK.
directDeltaAnalysis.taggedTemplateSurface: Cooked/raw array order, invalid cooked void 0, no-substitution arrays and substitutions after the helper argument preserve the scanner-visible boundaries relevant to the two findings.
directDeltaAnalysis.rawLiteralSource: Raw literal source extraction and CRLF/CR normalization match the pinned SDK getRawLiteral and the pinned native transformer approach. Range and UTF-8 substring failure paths return RUNTIME_HELPERS_ES5_TEMPLATE_RAW_UNAVAILABLE explicitly.

externalModuleCache.sourceAssessment: No direct predicate difference found from omission of the cache variable wrapper. For tag names require/define, both first arguments start with an Identifier rather than a string or [. Inside define dependency scanning, both encounter the cooked array first ]. The added wrapper uses identifiers, ||, = and parentheses; it introduces no braces, module keywords or string literals and does not change the commas before substitutions. Actual SDK JavaScript emission/cache semantics are intentionally not reproduced.
externalModuleCache.evidenceLevel: primary-source reasoning; no new reviewer execution or exhaustive cache-shape experiment

directDeltaAnalysis.runtimeChange: runtime_configuration.rs production logic is unchanged by this delta; only two tests with 15 vectors were added.

retainedEvidenceAudit.targetedGreen: review1.green.log and review2.green.log each report one executed passing test
retainedEvidenceAudit.aggregateGreen: runtime.green.log: 20 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored; 101 filtered out; finished in 0.31s

limits: Only this correction delta was reviewed. No broader original ES5-helper projection re-review or universal completeness claim.
No native/SDK query, Cargo command, build or test was run by the reviewer. Retained logs and their provenance were inspected independently.
The 140 development vectors cover their actual inputs. Qualification, cases and reserved content were neither read nor executed.
Other prototype sources evolved concurrently; full producer source closure is not certified. Stable owned modules and retained binary hashes establish only the stated bindings.
Native ES5/generator emission remains absent. The projection preserves a helper/import boolean surface, not emitted JavaScript execution or cache behavior.
No Windows native or Linux execution evidence was produced; the retained run and review host are macOS27.0.1 arm64.
Adoption into portable native code, full repository checks, CI, qualification and R0 remain outside this bounded verdict.
recommendation: Le delta ferme F1/F2 et peut poursuivre la chaîne de vérification prévue ; conserver les limites de projection et de provenance sans les convertir en certification globale.
